curatedMovie.curiosityHook: Locked away until they reach an impossible unanimous verdict, twelve strangers must lay bare their own prejudices to determine if a young Chechen is truly guilty.
curatedMovie.description: In contemporary Moscow, twelve jurors gather in a makeshift school gymnasium to decide the fate of a young Chechen man accused of murdering his step-father, an officer in the Russian army.
curatedMovie.vibeSummary: Deliberate, tense, and deeply reflective; an emotionally demanding Russian courtroom mystery built around sustained dialogue.
curatedMovie.whyWatch: Nikita Mikhalkov reframes a classic courtroom premise into a heavy chamber drama powered by intimate confessions, moral clashes, and haunting wartime memories.
